name: Zoom AD-16 Power Adapter 9V DC Adapter for Zoom MS-50G, MS-100BT, G3, G2, A2, and the B2 processors
description: Guitar Pedals & Effects - Get your Zoom pedals up and running with the Zoom AD-16 DC adapter power supply. This handy adapter serves up 9V to a variety of Zoom pedals including the MS-50G, MS-100BT, G3, G2, A2, and the B2 series processors. Never have your batteries run out at a gig again, the AD-16 AC adapter plugs into the wall and gives you the perfect power feed to ensure your processor is running at 100%. Power up with the Zoom AD-16 AC adapter.Zoom AD-16 AC Adapter Features: Power your favorite Zoom processor with this AC adapter. Works with MS-50G, MS-100BT, G3, G2, A2, and the B2 processors. 9V DC output @ 500mA (center negative). Keep your pedal powered with the Zoom AD-16 AC adapter. Pedal & Effects Accessories
